title: Happy Magic Comes with a Secret

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: PUNISH MENT☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
成　
敗　
☆

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Amazing! That many monsters disappeared in the blink of an eye! I did as you told me, Nanaka-chan, but what kind of magic was that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい！　
あんなにたくさん居た魔物があっという間に！
ナナカちゃんに言われた通りにしたけど、
なんの魔法だったの？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~ I used an application of the magic that you've used with me before, Hatsune-taso.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっへへ～
あのとき
ハツネたそが発動させた
転移魔法を応用したんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: I won't go into the details, but it's something like a magic spell that lets you exchange parts of a monster's body for other things.
text_block_list.orig_text:
細かい説明は省くけど、
魔物の体の一部と
他のものを交換する魔法、
みたいな感じかな。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: It's still an incomplete spell, since I can't use it by myself... but for now, that'll do just fine for me since it worked!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私一人じゃ扱えないから、
まだまだ未完成の魔法だけど、
とりあえず
成功してよかった。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Hm? I can't exchange anything too big, so I just swapped their parts with some pebbles that were lying around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
あんまり大きなものは扱えないから、
そこら辺に転がってる
小石を
ちょろちょろっと移しただけだよ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: With that much power at its disposal, it's quite a frightening spell. I think this'll be enough of a hint for a new magic. Yup.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでこれだけの威力なんだから
末恐ろしい魔法だよ。
う
んうん、
新しい魔法のヒントとしては
十分かな。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: But... we still haven't found any clues as to your memories, {0}. We'll keep up the good wo-... Wait, what? There's a strange stone lying around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
君の記憶の手がかりは
まだ見つかってないよね。
そっちもきちんと……
って、
ありゃりゃ？
何やら変わった石が転がっていますな。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Maybe I've had it teleported here from somewhere else? Hmm, I guess that means that magic's control is still out of whack.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どこからか
転移してきちゃったのかな？
うーん、
まだコントロールが甘いってことか。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: But! This stone's sparkle is just so pretty～
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
ピカピカ光って
きれいな石だね～

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: You're right~ Wait! WHAT'S GOING ON?! The light is getting stronger and stronger!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうでござるな～
って、
な、
なにこれ！？
光がどんどん強くなってない！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Heave ho, here it goes. Are you sure this spot is good enough?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よいっしょ、
っと。
本当にここで大丈夫かな？

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text: Yeah, we're right by my house, so don't worry. That said, you're pretty strong, young lady. You can carry heavy luggage with ease.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ、
ここがうちだから大丈夫よ。
それにしても
お嬢さんは力持ちねぇ。
重い荷物を軽々運んで。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: A-Ahaha~ Y-You're right on that, I guess I might be stronger than your average gal~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あはは～
確かに
人より力持ちかもしれないな～

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text: Oh my, sorry... that might've been a rude comment to offer to a young girl. Know that you really saved me. Thank you. See you later.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
女の子には失礼だったかね。
本当に助かったよ。
ありがとうね。
それじゃあ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Take care~
text_block_list.orig_text: お気をつけて～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Maybe carrying so much was a mistake?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふぅ。
ちょっと
持ち過ぎちゃったかな～？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I'm fine, don't worry! But I had to suppress my ESP powers there, so maybe that made me tired.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれくらい平気平気～
でも超能力を抑えめにしなきゃいけないから
逆に疲れちゃったかも。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's a reaction to holding back my strength~ You're the only eyes around here, {0}... So maybe it's fine if I relax a little...
text_block_list.orig_text:
力を抑えた反動かな～
キミしか見てないから
少しくらいなら……

text_block_list.text: W-WHAT'S THISSSS?! There's a girl floating in the air?! Amazing! It's just like the first transformation scene from Magical Girl Sweet Trick!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんですと～～～～！？　
宙に女の子が浮いてる！？
すごい！　
まんま魔法少女スイートトリックの
初回変身シーンだ！！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: EHH?! Whoa, whoa...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？　
わっ、
ととと……！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Hm? I was certain she looked like she was flying, but... Was it just my imagination? Wait, {0}-kun's here too! I was so surprised I didn't even notice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
確かに浮いてるように見えたんだけど……
気のせい？
って、
{0}君も居る！
あまりの驚きで気付かなかったよ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh? You know her?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
キミの知り合い？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: So, to get to the point... it looked like a scene from one of my favorite classic magical girl anime, and I got really excited.
text_block_list.orig_text:
と、
いうわけで
私が好きな
往年の名作
魔法少女アニメのワンシーンに見えて
テンションが上がってしまったというわけですよ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Sorry for startling you all of a sudden. But... you were floating, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いきなりビックリさせちゃって
ごめんね。
でも……
浮いてた、
よね？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: U-Umm, that's, umm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
え～～
っと、
それは、
あの～

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: What did you just say!? In other words, you're saying that Hatsune-taso is a fellow otaku warrior?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんですと！？
つまり初音たそも
同好の士というわけでござるか？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Ah, y-yeah! I guess... I am?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
う、
うん！
そう、
かな？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: It brings me to tears to meet someone in my generation who appreciates the same anime I do. Well, of course, a timeless masterpiece will appeal to any generation!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか
同年代にお仲間が居るとは思わなかったよ。
いや、
もちろん不朽の名作は
どんな世代にも刺さるものだけどね！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: But, that's perfect timing if I ever saw one. The remastered version of that anime in movie format is playing in the cinemas right now. Why don't we all go see it together?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
それならちょうどよかった。
今
映画館で劇場版のリマスター版が上映されてるんだ。
一緒に見に行かない？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: A-A movie format? "Re-masu-tah"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
げ、
劇場版？　
りますたー？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Nanaka-chan looks like she's having a lot of fun just speaking about it. That made me a little curious to go watch it too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
七々香ちゃん
とっても楽しそうだもんね。
私も見てみたいかも。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Sure, let's go together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
一緒に行こう！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Yay! Then, let me show you the way... to the movie theatre!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった！　
それじゃあ
映画館へ
いざ参らん！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Ugh, ugh... Egh... As expected, even after watching it over and over, it's still so good. The two finally come to understand each other, but after the battle they are separated across time and space... Even so, the ending leaves a spiral for a future reunion...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うぐっ……
えぐっ……
やはり
何度見てもいいものですな。
ようやく分かり合えた二人が、
戦いののち
時空を超えて
別たれる……
でも
再会への希望を残した終わり……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: *sigh* That just makes me want to rewatch the TV anime version all over again! ...Wait, Hatsune-taso? Why are you so quiet?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～
改めてテレビアニメ版も見返さねば！
……
って、
初音たそ？　
黙り込んでどうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: P-Please don't tell me that you didn't like the changes made to the remastered version?! It's true that it's hard to throw away the original's wild energy, but there's this and that to consider an-...
text_block_list.orig_text:
も、
もしや
リマスター版の作画修正が気に入らなかった！？
確かに
もともとの荒々しい勢いも捨てがたいけど、
今回のものは
それはそれで……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: It was sooo good!! And it was the first time I've ever screamed so loud in a movie theater!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すっっっ
ごくよかったよ！！
それに
映画館であんなに大声出したの初めてだよ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: The remastered has a part made just to have the fans cheer, after all. The sight of long-time fans cheering loudly creates a different experience compared to the one from the original movie.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょうど
応援上映の回だったからね。
長年のファンたちが
声を張り上げる光景は、
映画とは別の趣があるしね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: And to think that the rival girl was a character who couldn't use magic and instead relied on ESP...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに
まさかライバルの女の子が
魔法を使えない代わりに
超能力を身に付けた子だなんて……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Hatsune-taso?
text_block_list.orig_text: 初音たそ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: It's nothing! Just one of many reasons why I had so much fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんでもない！　
すっごく
楽しかった！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm glad you enjoyed it. Now, let's move on to the next fun part after watching the movie.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや～
楽しんでいただけたようで何より。
それでは
映画鑑賞後のお楽しみと参りましょう。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: There's still more?
text_block_list.orig_text: まだ何かあるの？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Of course there is. It's something any otaku who earns their name can't avoid. And that's... a post-show discussion on the way home!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん。
オタクには避けて通れぬものですぞ。
それは……
帰り道の
感想戦！！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: A distortion in space-time occurs there, and the two of them go separately to repair it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこで
時空の歪ができてしまい、
二人は別々に時空を修復するために……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. At first the main character tries to get to the other side, but the rival girl pushes him away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん。
最初は主人公が向こう側に行こうとするんだけど、
ライバルの女の子が突き飛ばして……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: There will be many people who will be sad if you were to disappear. As for me... nobody would.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたが消えたら悲しむ人がたくさんいるでしょ。
私は……
いないから。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: That's not true! After all, I'd be sad if you disappeared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことないよ！
だって、
私はあなたが消えたら悲しいもん！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: And right there, the rival girl...
text_block_list.orig_text: そこでライバルの女の子が……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: My life was full of lies and deceit, but at the very end, I finally got my hands on the real thing. That alone is enough to satisfy me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
騙し騙されで
嘘ばっかりの人生だったけど、
最後にようやく
ホンモノが手に入った。
それだけで
満足よ……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: That's the line! With the perfect expression that could be interpreted as either crying or laughing... Wait, Hatsune-taso?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう！
そこの
泣いてるとも笑ってるともとれる
絶妙な表情が……
って、
初音たそ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I... was lying to you, Nanaka-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
七々香ちゃんに
嘘ついてたの。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I... The truth is... I'm actually an ESPer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
本当は
超能力者なの！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Wh-What did you just say?! Th-This is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんですとっ！？
こ、
これは……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I don't want to lie to my friends, so... Nanaka-chan, what you saw back there was...
text_block_list.orig_text:
友達に
嘘は
つきたくないから……
あのとき七々香ちゃんが見たのは……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: A scene from the TV anime that was changed for the remastered movie!! I see, so know your stuff about roleplaying! I'll join you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
劇場版では改変された
テレビアニメ版のワンシーン！！
なるほど、
完全ななりきりというわけですな！
拙者も
お付き合いいたしますぞ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: You don't have to say anything. A secret suits a good woman better than tears, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何も言わなくていいのよ。
いい女には
涙より秘密が似合う、
でしょ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: U-Umm, that's not really it... I really...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
えっと、
そうじゃなくて……
私本当に……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: It's okay, I understand that it's something you're keeping secret. So I want you to believe in me, Hatsune-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいんだよ、
本当は私の中にあるもので。
だから初音ちゃんも、
私を信じてほしいな。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: You see, I've actually noticed all this time. But it's okay. We were able to understand each other properly in the end... right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私
本当は気付いてたよ。
でも、
いいの。
私たちは、
きちんと分かり合えた……
でしょ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: That's... true. But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは……
うん。
でも…………

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Hatsune-chan, you've tried really hard to make a lie come true. Then in that case, it's the truth now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
初音ちゃんは嘘を本当にしようとして頑張ったんでしょ。
だったらもうそれは
本当だよ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: The two of us... we're real friends already. And your ESP power is one that can make someone smile, Hatsune-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちは
もう本当の友達だし、
初音ちゃんの超能力は
誰かを幸せにできる魔法だよ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: After all, you're already capable of reproducing a scene like this so perfectly. So for you to be able to fly in the air is no big deal, Hatsune-taso.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これだけ完璧に再現シーンができるんだもん。
初音たそなら
宙に浮くぐらいなんでもないよね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Nanaka-chan...
text_block_list.orig_text: 七々香ちゃん……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Now then, Hatsune-taso. Let's continue the post-game discussion! The fun is just beginning!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっ、
初音たそ。
感想戦の続きと参りましょう！
お楽しみはこれからですぞ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: うん！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Huh? Did I fall asleep again? That's strange. I didn't use my ESP at all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んんぅ……
あれ？　
私また寝ちゃってた？
おかしいな、
超能力は使ってないはずなのに……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Somewhere other than here... Someone other than me... Memories that shouldn't exist... Things I don't want to forget, but I have...
text_block_list.orig_text:
むぅ……
ここではないどこか……
私ではない私……
存在しないはずの記憶……
忘れたくないのに、
忘れてしまったもの……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that was a happy dream about a past I once had.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
私としたことが、
幸せな夢を見たもんだ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: N-Nanaka-chan? Don't tell me... did we happen to share the same dream?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナ、
ナナカちゃん？
ひょっとして
ナナカちゃんも同じ夢を……？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me, Hatsune-taso, you saw it too?! What's that supposed to mean...? Ah! Was that a clue to {0}'s memories?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさかハツネたそも！？
あれはいったい……
あ、
あれがひょっとして
君の記憶の手がかり？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: I see... In that case, I guess you could say... we've accomplished our objective, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか……
それじゃあ一応
目的は果たした、
のかな？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Ah, u-um... Actually there's something I want to tell you, Nanaka-chan...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
えっ、
えっと……
私
ナナカちゃんに言わなきゃいけないことが……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: It's okay, I already know what you want to say without you putting it into words. "A secret suits a good woman better than tears", remember?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいよ、
言葉にしなくても分かるものは分かるから。
いい女には
涙より秘密が似合う、
でしょ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: ...! Nanaka-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！
ナナカちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Besides, I'm so exhausted from using magic all over the place, I'm not even sure I can listen to a serious story properly right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに私
魔法使いまくって
ヘトヘト～
シリアスな話をちゃんと聞ける自信ないよ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Let's go home for today. We'll have this talk in private another time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日のところはもう帰ろう。
内緒のトークはまた今度、
ってことで。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. You're right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
そうだね。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Nanaka and Hatsune, who understood each other without exchanging words, descended the tower with satisfaction.
text_block_list.orig_text:
言葉を交わさずとも何か分かり合えたナナカとハツネは、
満足げに塔を下りていくのであった。
